shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- db ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' lib/db.js && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- git status ---\\n' && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- git diff package ---\\n' && git diff -- package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n--- diff stat ---\\n' && git diff --stat && printf '\\n--- page lines ---\\n' && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,180p' && printf '\\n--- layout lines ---\\n' && nl -ba app/layout.tsx | sed -n '1,100p' && printf '\\n--- tsconfig diff ---\\n' && git diff -- tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short && git diff --check'
